en.headline: HKU rises to 62nd and CityU to 95th in global academic ranking
en.dek: Both universities enter the top 100 of the 2026 Academic Ranking of World Universities released by ShanghaiRanking, with HKU improving five places and CityU four.
body: The University of Hong Kong climbed five places to 62nd in the 2026 Academic Ranking of World Universities published by ShanghaiRanking Consultancy, while City University of Hong Kong rose four places to 95th, securing a second consecutive year inside the global top 100.

Seven Hong Kong institutions appeared in the top 1,000. The Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University were placed in the 101–150 band, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology in 201–300, and Hong Kong Baptist University and Lingnan University in 601–700.

HKU said the result marked its fifth consecutive year of improvement in the ranking and reaffirmed its position as the leading local university. CityU highlighted gains in highly cited researchers and other research indicators.

zh.headline: 港大及城大躋身軟科世界大學排名百強
zh.dek: 2026年軟科世界大學學術排名公布，港大升5位至全球第62，城大升4位至第95，連續第二年進入百強。
body: 上海軟科公布2026年世界大學學術排名，香港大學較去年上升5位至全球第62位，香港城市大學上升4位至第95位，連續第二年躋身全球百強。
本港共有7所大學進入全球前1,000名。香港中文大學及香港理工大學位列101至150名區間，香港科技大學位列201至300名，香港浸會大學及嶺南大學則位列601至700名。
港大表示，這是連續第五年在該排名刷新紀錄，並繼續蟬聯本地第一。城大則指在高被引科學家等研究指標有所提升。
